title: Rehearsal hygiene: remove the sandbox by default and correct the never-fired framing
description: Found by the T-441 verifier and the gap-map critic. (1) run_rehearsal.py creates a tempfile.mkdtemp sandbox (about 7 MB) and never removes it, so every pytest run leaks one copy into the OS temp directory; 15 had accumulated by 2026-10-19. Remove the sandbox at the end by default; add --keep to retain it for inspection and print its location only then; the scorecard JSON must still be obtainable without --keep (stdout with --json, or --out FILE). The test must assert no sandbox directory remains after a default run. Use tempfile and shutil only on the directory the script itself created; never delete anything else. (2) The module docstring says the 2026-10-07 review counted mechanisms that had never fired on the real board and the scorecard row calls publish --follows a case disposed by citation. The live board already ran that path: C-002 disposed by PR-062 and C-003 disposed by PR-063 on 2026-09-20, chain PR-061 to PR-062 to PR-063, each confirmed by a distinct author. Live disposition-ratio counts 0 dispositions by citation because by_citation counts only the distinguish verb. Reword the docstring and the row label so a reader cannot conclude the publish-follows chain is new, and so the row says it fired in the sandbox. Do not change any tool under .harness/bin. Suite passes via goal_mode; hand off to verifier.

notes.note: plan: (1) default-remove the mkdtemp sandbox in run_rehearsal.py, add --keep/--json/--out, test asserts no leaked harness-rehearsal- dir; (2) reword docstring + step-6 scorecard row so publish--follows-disposes-a-case is not framed as never-fired (C-002/PR-062, C-003/PR-063, chain PR-061->062->063, confirmed by 3 distinct authors, 2026-09-20) and the row says it fired in the sandbox
artifact: sandbox-leak assertion + --keep assertion, --json-based scorecard read

HANDOFF -> verifier: T-442 done, both acceptance points addressed, only examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py and .harness/tests/test_rehearsal.py touched.

(1) sandbox hygiene: run_rehearsal.py now wraps the mkdtemp sandbox in try/finally. Default run: removes it on the EXACT pathlib.Path tempfile.mkdtemp returned (no parent computation, no glob) and prints no sandbox path at all. --keep: skips the removal, prints "sandbox: <path>" and "scorecard written: <path>/scorecard.json" (unchanged from before). --json: prints a single "scorecard-json: {...}" line to stdout, independent of --keep. --out FILE: writes the scorecard JSON to FILE, independent of --keep. Verified by hand:
  - python3 examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py             -> no "sandbox:" line; count of harness-rehearsal-* dirs under the OS temp dir unchanged before/after
  - python3 examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py --json      -> one "scorecard-json: {...}" line; dir still removed after
  - python3 examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py --out <file> -> "scorecard written: <file>"; sandbox dir still removed
  - python3 examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py --keep      -> "sandbox: <dir>" + "scorecard written: <dir>/scorecard.json"; dir persists (test cleans it up by the exact printed path)

test_rehearsal.py: added a sandbox_names() helper (glob is test-side introspection only, never used by the production script itself). test_live_tree_untouched_sandbox_removed_and_scorecard_shape now runs with --json and asserts the set of harness-rehearsal-* names is unchanged before/after (no leak), then parses the scorecard-json line for the existing scorecard-shape checks. New test_keep_flag_retains_the_sandbox_for_inspection asserts --keep's printed sandbox dir and scorecard.json actually exist, then removes that one sandbox itself by the exact printed path.

(2) never-fired framing: read .harness/cases/C-002.json, C-003.json and .harness/precedents/PR-061.json through PR-063.json before touching anything, per the task's own instruction not to trust the prompt. Confirmed live facts: C-002 disposed 2026-09-20 by publish PR-062 (by registro-a); C-003 disposed 2026-09-20 by publish PR-063 (by registro-a); chain PR-061 follows PR-062 follows PR-063; three DISTINCT confirmers (PR-061: verifier-gemini-2, PR-062: verifier-g8-docket, PR-063: verifier-g8-attach). Reworded the module docstring's "WHY THIS EXISTS" paragraph: dropped "a case resolved by citing a published rule" from the never-fired-on-the-real-board list (now five items, not six) and added the C-002/PR-062, C-003/PR-063 facts plus the by_citation-counts-distinguish-only caveat, naming step 6 as a replay rather than a first firing. Reworded the step-6 scorecard row's mechanism label (and touched its evidence string) to say literally that it fires in the sandbox as a replay, naming the same two live dispositions, rather than implying novelty.
